scope: ARKAON Pattern Foundry: Railway preparation through reviewed activation
operator_language: Present implemented deliverables and previews first. When the user elects actual operations, explain development and verification needed for GitHub, Railway when backend is needed, and Netlify. Then guide one visible action at a time. A staged service is not an active deployment.

phases.action: Show implemented artifact, preview and exact available/pending capabilities before any deployment setup request.
hold_when: a preview is claimed as a functioning public service

phases.action: Record repository, exact branch and commit, chained PR order, draft and CI state, and readiness locks.
proof: successful CI for the exact SHA
hold_when: a required PR is draft or conflicting
CI is missing or failing
deployment lock is false

phases.action: Add Railway PostgreSQL in the project; keep its network private. It owns its own volume.
hold_when: database is unavailable
database credentials are copied into the repository or chat

phases.action: Create web service from the reviewed GitHub commit; attach a separate volume at /data; use one replica.
hold_when: web volume is confused with postgres-volume
service creation is staged but settings cannot be configured
application writes are routed to ephemeral checkout
Railway GitHub App does not list the exact repository
GitHub App authorization scope exceeds the one approved repository
GitHub authentication is incomplete
production branch is auto-connected to main while deployment lock remains false

phases.action: Allocate an HTTPS web domain; register a GitHub OAuth App with exact callback /console/auth/callback; set client ID, client secret, numeric allowed owner ID, tenant UUID, public origin, and session secret in Railway service variables.
proof: exact HTTPS origin and callback match
hold_when: OAuth variables are incomplete
secrets appear in logs, source or chat
public console has no verified owner login

phases.action: Apply reversible DB migrations to Railway Postgres; provision the designated tenant; confirm volume persistence, process health, owner-only console, URL observation egress, and backup/restore process.
hold_when: health is the only evidence
tenant is not provisioned
migration or restore is untested

phases.action: Present evidence and exact change to the operator; update readiness only after each required gap is closed and reviewed; activate only the approved scope and record rollback.
hold_when: PRODUCT_IMPLEMENT_HOLD remains
deployment lock remains false
any evidence is stale

user_interaction.meaning_of_confirmation: Step 1 means the user inspected the current artifact; later clicks are user assertions about external screens, not provider verification.
future_write_requirements: one action per explicit user click and preview of cost/scope
no activation while readiness lock is false
